body: Flat cel-shaded comic reaction, locked front camera. A small green tree frog wearing round wire glasses sits behind a silver laptop and alternates its webbed paws while typing quickly. Add tiny white motion arcs and one brief glint on a lens. The hands return to the starting keyboard position on the final frame. Warm cream-and-teal background, bold outlines, no text.
